# Descriptions
@@ 1
Heats 1 cubic foot of liquid per level to boiling, at a rate of 50º per round
of concentration. Caster is immune to the heat.
@@ 2
As Boil Water, except the liquid can be cooled until frozen.
@@ 3
As Boil Water, except that it clears liquid of all sediment.
@@ 5
As Boil Water, except that it removes all dissolved substances from the
liquid.
@@ 6
Creates a 10'x10'x1' wall of churning water (a water source must be within
10'). All attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty, and all movement is
reduced by 80%.
@@ 7
As Boil Water, except all the liquid is evaporated at a rate of 1 cubic foot
per round of concentration.
@@ 8
Creates a corridor through liquid up to 100' long, 3' wide, and 10' deep (must
be open at the top).
@@ 9
A bolt of water is shot from the palm of the caster (a water source must be
within 10'). Attack results are determined using the Water Bolt Attack Table
13.9 (p. 88).
@@ 10
As Waterwall, except wall is 10'x20'x1' and can be curved up to a semicircle.
@@ 11
All water within a 100' radius is calmed. Waves are cut by 20' in the center
of the area of effect (less towards the perimeter). This will negate the
effects of currents in the area of effect.
@@ 13
As Waterwall, except has a set duration.
@@ 15
As Water Corridor I, except limit is 300'x4'x50' deep.
@@ 17
Creates a 20' radius whirlpool that will draw in any unpowered objects up to
200' away. Powered objects may make a very hard movement manuever to resist
the pull of the whirlpool.
@@ 18
Creates a wave moving away from the caster. Wave is 1' high per level at the
center and 10' per level wide.
@@ 19
Creates a bubble of air (10' radius) around the caster and others. The bubble
will carry them in up to 100' of water (air is resuscitated). The caster must
concentrate to move the bubble (without concentration it will simply rise to
the surface). At the end of the duration, the bubble will begin to rise to the
surface. All objects inside the bubble will rise with it. After reaching the
surface, the bubble will burst.
@@ 20
As Calm Water, except radius is 100' per level and waves are cut by 50'.
@@ 25
As Water Corridor, except limit is 100' per level x 6' x 100' deep.
@@ 30
As Water Bubble, except radius is 20' and there is no depth limitation.
@@ 50
The caster can use one of the lower spells on this list each round, with a
range of 10' per level.
